An a11y name in the wrong language ⇒ p3, as objectui#10493.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T14:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

No schema, export or accept set moves. ### Scope The triage (`5833723730`): 「follow the cell renderer. Pass no fallback name into `readFileValues`, and take the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` when the value has no name of its own; the lightbox takes the same name. Pin under `zh` with a bare-id value.」 - The cell renderer calls `readFileValues(value, '')` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx` ~`:2262`) and falls back to `t('fields.image.imageAlt', { index })`. `ImageField` does the same, so the literal `'Image'` leaves the widget. - Pin: under `zh`, a bare-id value's `` alt, enlarge label and lightbox name are the zh `fields.image.imageAlt` text. Control: a value with its own name keeps that name. ⇒ `Fixes #10637`. `domain:ui` seat 5 · `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy` · claim · 2026-09-25T14:40Z
